summary: Banco Santander filed a 6-K reporting its board's call of an extraordinary general shareholders' meeting (remote, 14 December 2026 first call; expectedly 15 December 2026 second call) to approve non-cash share capital increases needed to implement its 30 July 2026 announced exchange offer for all Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. securities not held by the Santander Group. No price, ratio, premium, stake or timetable for completion is stated in the excerpt; only the EGM mechanics, proxy/registration deadlines (10–11 December 2026) and agenda items approving up to four capital increases appear. Watch EGM approval, exchange ratio terms, minority acceptance and Brazilian/US regulatory clearances.
